what.text: This page follows refugees from Rwanda living in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 198125 there, 81.1% of all Rwandan refugees and more than in any other host country.
Uganda hosts the next largest number.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Rwanda with the FPR from 1990 to 1994, at war level in 1990 and 1994.
From 1996 to 2025 it records later periods of conflict with groups including the ALiR and the FDLR-FOCA.

when.text: The main years of displacement in the data are 1994 and 1995.
UNHCR's figure for the Democratic Republic of the Congo peaked at 1252837 in 1994 and fell to 11816 by 2004.
Returns from the Democratic Republic of the Congo to Rwanda were highest in 1996 in UNHCR's returns data.

how.text: These are year-end totals of refugees in the Democratic Republic of the Congo only, and UNHCR adds notes to some of them.
Since 2017 the figure has changed very slowly.
The sources don't say which routes people took or where in the country they live.
